definition: A chart where each category is a bar of the same width, and the height of the bar shows its frequency; a dual bar chart puts bars for two groups side by side, and a composite bar chart stacks the parts of each total into one bar.
A circle cut into sectors, one for each category, where each sector's angle is proportional to its frequency, so the angles add up to $360^\circ$.
A chart that shows frequencies with a repeated symbol, with a key saying how many items one whole symbol stands for.
A diagram that lists data in order by splitting each value into a stem (its first digits) and a leaf (its last digit), with a key showing how to read an entry.
